title: City Council — May 5, 2026 Work Session and Business Meeting

votes.motion: MOTION: Council Member Holton moved to ADJOURN the City Council Work Session. The motion was seconded by Council Member Hyland

MOTION: Council Member Hyland moved to APPROVE Resolution 2026-27 Authorizing and Clarifying Certain Retirement Contributions and Benefits. The motion was seconded by Council Member Newell. Vote on Motion: Council Member Newell-Yes; Council Member Hyland-Yes; Council Member Holton-Yes; Mayor Bennion-Yes

MOTION: Council Member Newell moved to APPROVE Resolution 2026-28. The motion was seconded by Council Member Hyland. Vote on Motion: Council Member Hyland-Yes; Council Member Holton-No; Council Member Newell-Yes; Mayor Bennion-Yes

MOTION: Council Member Newell moved to APPROVE Resolution 2026-29 as an acknowledgement. The motion was seconded by Council Member Holton. Vote on Motion: Council Member Hyland-Yes; Council Member Holton-Yes; Council Member Newell-Yes; Mayor Bennion-Yes

MOTION: Council Member Hyland moved to APPROVE Resolution 2026-30 acknowledging that we are setting this public meeting and giving notice to the Tax Commission as required by the State Code. The motion was seconded by Council Member Newell. Vote on Motion: Council Member Holton-Yes; Council Member Hyland-Yes; Council Member Newell-Yes; Mayor Bennion-Yes
MOTION: Council Member Holton moved to ADJOURN. The motion was seconded by Council Member Hyland
